aiBrief.scopeSection: Scope to a section — available after generation

brief.label: Brief
brief.description: Persistent context the AI sees on every chat. Brand, voice, constraints, reminders.
brief.placeholder:
e.g.

- This is a landing for Counter, a coffee shop in Polanco.
- Voice: warm, friendly, no tech jargon.
- Accent: warm orange (#C66B3D).
- To do: ask the designer for the final logo.
brief.emptyHint: Open a project from the Pages tab to write its brief.

templates.heading: Curated templates
templates.intro: Click a card to preview it big. When you're ready, hit Use this template in the banner to clone it into a new project.
templates.newProjectWarning: Picking a template starts a new project. Your current project stays saved in /projects.
templates.footer: Templates are static HTML — pure markup, Tailwind CDN, Google Fonts. Cloning makes them yours; only your project claims a subdomain when you hit Deploy.

sections.heading: Section library
sections.intro: Insert a section into your current page. It drops in at the bottom — drag it into place with the section handles. The look adapts to your page on the next restyle.
sections.jsTooltip: Renders content via JS — preserved on insert, limited inline-edit
sections.imgTooltip: Ships gradient placeholders — swap real images after insert
sections.footer: Sections are scoped fragments — their styles can't clash with your page. Insert, then reorder and restyle to taste.

paste.heading: Paste HTML
paste.description: Drop in the HTML claude.ai gave you (or any self-contained landing page HTML). We'll host it on your subdomain.
paste.projectNamePlaceholder: Auto-detected from the page title if blank
paste.deployHint: Next: click Deploy to publish to a subdomain.
